page: Microsoft Azure NC48ads_A100_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for high-throughput parallel compute, deep learning training, and large-scale model inference. It is powered by 48 dedicated physical cores from the AMD EPYC 7V13 processor running on the x86_64 architecture at 3.7 GHz. The hardware architecture features 440 GB of system memory, providing approximately 9.17 GB per core. The instance includes two NVIDIA A100 GPUs based on the Ampere architecture with a combined total of 160 GB of VRAM, paired with 2,057 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark results demonstrate exceptional capability in AI and parallel processing tasks. The dual A100 GPUs place prompt processing and text generation in the top tier across medium (7B) and large (70B) language models, reaching 3,522.73 tokens per second in 7B prompt evaluation and 501.25 tokens per second in 70B prompt evaluation. Compute capacity is reinforced by robust multi-threaded processing, reflected in a Geekbench multi-core score of 17,886 and PassMark CPU score of 64,635.14. Image processing ranks in the top ten percent at 17,947, while local cached memory bandwidth achieves 5,095.95 GB/sec.

From an architectural standpoint, the combination of dedicated non-hyperthreaded cores, 160 GB aggregate GPU memory, high host memory density, and low-latency NVMe scratch space delivers balanced throughput for intensive pipelines. A key architectural tradeoff is the absence of AVX-512 and AMX instructions on the AMD EPYC 7V13 processor, shifting dense matrix multiplication workloads entirely to the NVIDIA Ampere tensor cores. Single-threaded metrics, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1,726, align with middle-tier expectations, confirming that performance scaling depends heavily on multi-threading and GPU acceleration.

The NC48ads_A100_v4 is suited for distributed machine learning training, large language model (LLM) serving, high-performance computing (HPC) simulations, image rendering, and batch data processing pipelines requiring high GPU VRAM and fast local storage caching.
description: Microsoft Azure NC48ads_A100_v4 is a high-density, GPU-accelerated virtual machine equipped with 48 dedicated physical cores from an AMD EPYC 7V13 processor operating at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server incorporates 440 GB of system memory, 2,057 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, and two NVIDIA A100 Ampere GPUs offering an aggregate of 160 GB VRAM. Benchmark testing highlights top-tier performance in deep learning inference, processing up to 3,522.73 tokens per second on 7B LLM prompts, alongside strong multi-core compute metrics with a PassMark CPU score of 64,635.14. While single-threaded CPU throughput remains moderate, the hardware is optimized for parallel workloads. NC48ads_A100_v4 is primarily suited for large language model deployment, AI model fine-tuning, complex computer vision pipelines, and GPU-intensive high-performance computing workloads.
